acceptance: Root cause named: the query or phase that hangs or slows, with a stack or timing evidence, and the commit or dependency change responsible (or proof it is a pre-existing flake with its rate).
Fix merged with a test that would have caught it where practical, or an owner decision recorded.
The cell passes in two consecutive nightly trunk UAT runs with no rerun (run ids recorded).
context:
2026-11-19: root cause and fix #4396 (merge 5637766a). benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/statement_settings.py forced the spilling grace hash join on tpchavoc 5_v7 as well as 5_v8; only 5_v8 exceeds the 8 GiB query limit. Local SF1 power phase 818 s -> 123 s; 5_v7 167-221 s x4 -> 12-14 s; default join passes 5_v7 under a 3 GiB limit. Faulthandler dumps showed one long chdb query, not a hang. Ruled out: chdb 4.1.6 vs 4.5.0 (both ~200 s for 5_v7 under grace hash), SQL translation (all 220 tpchavoc final SQL identical 50fedc71 vs develop). The setting predates 50fedc71; best reading is the cell was already ~418 s and a slower hosted runner pushed it past 1200 s. Remaining: two consecutive green nightlies.

2026-11-22 closing evidence, read live from GitHub: the shard passed on attempt 1, with no rerun, in three consecutive scheduled trunk UAT runs: 44712884700 (2026-11-20, 03b2c0186e), 44888589677 (2026-11-21, 3e09d4f43b) and 45007293835 (2026-11-22, 93f336032a). Owner decision 2026-11-22 (choice dialog): finish this item with the three run ids recorded.
description:
Nightly trunk UAT 44500662749 (develop 3d7619ee, 2026-11-19) stage 1 datafusion-clickhouse-local: clickhouse-local tpchavoc 1.0 hit the 1200 s UAT timeout twice (in-harness retry at 11:37), peak RSS 2.22 GiB, no subprocess output captured. tpchavoc 0.01 and 0.1 passed in 23 s and 43 s. The cell passed in the previous nightly 44278856759 (50fedc71) and in release-v2 44417177182 (v0.5.2rc3). A hang or a large slowdown on develop between 50fedc71 and 3d7619ee is likely; chdb-embedded-server-recursive-mutex-flake may be related.

Decision gate: raising the 1200 s timeout or pruning the cell needs explicit owner approval; fixing a BenchBox regression does not.

Guardrails: no timeout increase, retry or prune to make it green; reproduce locally through make heavy-run with the same command (benchbox run --platform clickhouse-local --benchmark tpchavoc --scale 1.0 --phases load,power) and capture a stack dump (py-spy or faulthandler) of the hang before fixing; bisect develop commits between 50fedc71 and 3d7619ee touching clickhouse-local, chdb, tpchavoc or the load path.
